mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the cases when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the cases when UNRATE < 4% over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the cases when HOUST is increasing over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the cases when INDPRO MoM < -1% over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the cases when FEDFUNDS > 5% over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the cases when RSAFS > 0% and UNRATE < 4% over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the cases when PAYEMS > 300,000 over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a recessionary regime.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the cases when GDPC1 QoQ < -1% during a recessionary regime over a 5-year period.
